newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGE Delahaye raises rating on Air Liquide.
newsitem.headline: SGE Delahaye raises rating on Air Liquide.

text.p: Brokerage SGE Delahaye raised its rating on chemicals supplier Air Liquide to 'neutral' from 'underperform', saying the share was at the right level after a correction following disappointing first-half results, portfolio managers said on Wednesday.

They said SGE Delahaye raised its earnings per share estimates for Air Liquide to 37.60 francs this year from 37.30 previously and to 40.50 francs in 1997 from 39.20. They said Air Liquide indicated it would step up its cost-reduction programme.
The stock, which stood at 845 francs on September 25 before Air Liquide posted its results, was down 0.26 percent at 776 at 1130 GMT.
